game_title: Capstone Boss Chain – Buried Temple Steps Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps, steps of a half-buried temple: the camel trader must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Capstone Boss Chain: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks.
theme: Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps: steps of a half-buried temple
core_gameplay_loop: In Buried Temple Steps, repeat each round: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the camel trader ahead. Then check the boss_hp value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the camel pen by solving code steps involving boss_hp that move the camel trader forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the camel pen first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 4 (applied tier): Capstone Boss Chain
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Capstone Boss Chain' (Week 9 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Buried Temple Steps'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how boss_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Buried Temple Steps.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
